deskSetAdvIntro: Off by default. Each switch shows one more part of the wallet, where it belongs.
deskSetAdvOutputsHint: The Outputs page in the sidebar: the coins the balance is made of, Split and Consolidate, and the defaults a send uses. A split or consolidation in progress keeps the page either way.
deskSetAdvTechnicalHint: The Technical fold on a transaction: slate ID, kernel, block height, the core's status and type, the payment proof; the Advanced folds in Invoices.
deskSetAdvSendOptionsHint: The fold on Send with the strategy (Smallest or All outputs) and Split change for one send. The defaults stay on Outputs.
deskSetAdvFilesHint: The File method on Send and Receive, with Finalize and Import: a payment as a file handed over any way, signed and handed back. For a wallet that uses no relay. A file payment in progress keeps the method visible.
deskSetAdvDirectHint: Receiving at this computer's own address over HTTP or Tor, beside Epicbox: the Direct method on Send, the HTTP and Tor addresses on Receive, and their settings under Receiving. A listener that is on keeps its rows.
deskSetAdvServerDetailsHint: Hosts, latency, version and block height in the node and Epicbox lists, on the sidebar's status rows and in the status card.
deskSetAdvRecheckHint: Recheck balance and Restore can start from a block height instead of the first block, and Recheck can drop unconfirmed transactions. Faster, and the only way to skip early history.
deskSetAdvBuiltInNodeHint: A node on this computer: the This computer option under Node, its sync panel, and Start node on Overview. The chain takes hours to sync and several gigabytes. A node that is running keeps its rows.
deskSetAdvLogsHint: The Logs group under Help: open the log folder, clear the logs. Report a problem attaches the log either way.
deskSetAdvNetworkHint: One choice for how the wallet reaches the network. Standard connects directly and leaves Tor to the Privacy switch. Tor first starts Tor with the wallet and asks before falling back to a direct connection. Tor only never connects directly: without Tor the wallet stays offline and says so in the sidebar. Offline uses no network at all; transaction files still work.
deskSetAdvModeStandardText: Connects directly. Tor can be turned on under Privacy.
deskSetAdvModeTorFirstText: Starts Tor with the wallet. If Tor fails, the wallet asks before it connects directly.
deskSetAdvModeTorOnlyText: Every connection goes through Tor. Without Tor the wallet stays offline and says so.
deskSetAdvModeOfflineText: No network. The balance stays as last seen; transaction files still work.
deskSetAdvTorOnlyNote: Tor only turns HTTP receiving off: a plain address would show this computer.
deskSetAdvOfflineNote: Offline pauses Epicbox, Direct receiving, the node and status checks until the mode changes.
